item.description:
Get ready to play with color, pattern, and shape in this fun, whimsical collage workshop! You'll create your very own Funky Floral artwork using painted papers, colorful patterns, and playful floral and leaf shapes.
You'll make your own painted collage papers, add colorful patterns with paint pens, then get snipping and cutting your flowers and leaves. From there, you'll experiment with composition and arrange your pieces into a funky floral design that's uniquely yours. Create a 9x11 artwork or a collection of notecards and gift tags!
The emphasis is on having fun and playing with your creativity, even if you've never created a collage before. Sally-Ann will demonstrate each step and cheer you on along the way.

item.title: BEAT: Belew/Vai/Levin/Bozzio Performing the Music of KING CRIMSON — Sat Oct 10, 8:00 PM — Blue Note Napa Summer Sessions
item.description:
Following more than 100 acclaimed performances across North and South America, Europe, and Japan, BEAT returns this fall for the last North American tour. Former King Crimson members Adrian Belew and Tony Levin are joined by guitar virtuoso Steve Vai and legendary drummer Terry Bozzio to perform the music of the three landmark 1980s King Crimson albums: Discipline, Beat, and Three of a Perfect Pair. Rather than attempting to recreate the original recordings, BEAT brings this extraordinary music to life with the spirit, precision, and adventurousness that made it so enduring. Whether you've lived with these albums for decades or are discovering them for the first time, this is the final opportunity to experience one of progressive music's most celebrated catalogs performed by four of the best musicians on the planet.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.description:
Join an immersive, hands-on culinary series at Quivira Vineyards, offered June 7-November 15 from 11 AM - 2 PM. Led by Estate Chef Julia, guests begin in the organic estate garden harvesting seasonal ingredients before moving to the open-air kitchen to prepare a garden-inspired, multi-course meal. This interactive experience highlights the connection between garden, vineyard, and kitchen, while teaching practical culinary techniques. The evening concludes with a shared meal paired with Quivira wines in a beautiful estate setting. Each date features a different focus, including handmade pasta, masa and tacos, stuffed pasta, global dumplings, and seasonal pie baking. Space is limited for these unique seasonal classes.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.description: Each month, the Poetry Book Club meets online to discuss one must-read book of poems, whether a timeless classic or an award-winning contemporary. ABOUT THE BOOK Shortlisted for the 2002 National Book Award in Poetry.
